title: Binary Covering Sequence (9,1) Verification and Exact Search
description: Verification and exact-search toolkit with a checked 71-bit certificate and a complete finite classification proving that no valid 70-bit radius-1 cover has exact overlap 61 with one fixed 64-edge backbone. Combined with the maximum-overlap theorem, every valid 70-bit cover has backbone overlap at most 60. No new bound on L(9,1) is claimed.
